column1: # Secured channels and user tokens for scripts/lib.sh run_secure_cases, with the
# identities of the test PKI (certs/generate.sh). Each server adapter named here runs once,
# with its certificate, and takes the clients in the order of this file.
#   1  id        stable dotted scenario id of results.json; never change it
#   2  clients   comma-separated adapters; @own is the adapter whose capabilities say
#   4  exit      expected exit code of the client; "-" when only the document counts
#   5  expect    jq filter that must hold on the result document
#   6  operation arguments of "client"; the runner adds --endpoint after the first word.
#                $M is the namespace prefix of the model.
#                @cred    --certificate, --private-key of the client's identity, --trust-list the CA
#                @bad     the same with an identity no one trusts
#                @badca   the client's identity, --trust-list a certificate that issued no server
